printer_profile.why: every tolerance and the bed size come from this file; the built-in fallback is an Elegoo Centauri Carbon

wall_mm.why: five 0.4 mm perimeters. The profile's 0.8 mm minimum is a floor, not a target

bed_fit.why: a part is designed at the size it SHOULD be — a bed_fit fail with a feasible split is print planning, not a design fault

export_formats.why: stl for the slicer, step for anyone who has to edit it in CAD, 3mf to carry the plate layout

history.note: materialised from the part template — 4 settings, all at their default
